G'oya

Natijadagi har bir qator bitta yozilish, shuning uchun so'rov enrollments dan boshlanadi. Talaba va kursni oddiy JOIN bilan ulaymiz. O'qituvchi esa bo'lmasligi mumkin, u LEFT JOIN bilan ulanadi.

Yechim

SELECT s.name AS student, c.title AS course, t.name AS teacher
FROM enrollments e
JOIN students s ON s.id = e.student_id
JOIN courses c ON c.id = e.course_id
LEFT JOIN teachers t ON t.id = c.teacher_id

teachers yozilishga emas, kursga ulanadi: t.id = c.teacher_id. Namunada Statistikaning teacher_id si NULL, Aziz va Jasurning shu kursdagi yozilishlari teacher ustunida NULL bilan chiqadi.

Tuzoqlar

Uchala ulanishni ham oddiy JOIN qilsangiz, o'qituvchisiz kurslardagi yozilishlar yo'qoladi. Namunada 5 qator o'rniga 3 ta qoladi:

Noto'g'riSELECT s.name AS student, c.title AS course, t.name AS teacher
FROM enrollments e
JOIN students s ON s.id = e.student_id
JOIN courses c ON c.id = e.course_id
JOIN teachers t ON t.id = c.teacher_id

Teskari xato: students dan boshlab hammasini LEFT JOIN qilish. Unda hech qaysi kursga yozilmagan talaba ham NULL kurs bilan chiqadi, so'ralgani esa yozilishlar ro'yxati.
